question: Which of the following persons is associated with the sport of shooting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manu Bhakar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manu Bhakar** is a renowned Indian sportsperson associated with the sport of **shooting**. She has represented India in various national and international shooting competitions.
 
• She gained prominence for her exceptional performance in the **10m Air Pistol** and **25m Pistol events**.
 
• Manu Bhakar won a gold medal at the **2018 ISSF World Cup**, becoming one of the youngest Indian shooters to achieve this feat.
 
• She also clinched gold medals at the **2018 Commonwealth Games** and the **2019 ISSF World Cup finals**, solidifying her position as a top-tier shooter.
 
• Her achievements have made her a key figure in Indian shooting sports, and she continues to inspire young athletes in the country.

• **Significance of Shooting in India:**

• Organizations like the **National Rifle Association of India (NRAI)** play a key role in promoting and supporting shooting sports in the country.
